title: Gold Bar Reload Raspberry Watermelon Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2 x Pods
description: Raspberry Watermelon flavour Gold Bar Reload prefilled pods weave together the tangy zest of raspberries with the lush sweetness of watermelon, creating a beautifully balanced blend that's both refreshing and deeply satisfying. This flavour captures the essence of summer with every puff, combining the bright, tartness of freshly picked raspberries with the cool, hydrating burst of watermelon. It’s an invigorating mix that perfectly suits those looking for a fruity, flavourful vape that delivers a taste of sunshine and outdoor fun. The Gold Bar Reload Pod Kit is designed for vapers seeking a convenient, compact device for premium vaping on the go. It mirrors the elegance and sophistication of the Gold Bar range, offering a reusable solution without the need to dispose of the whole device, thanks to its compatibility with Reload prefilled pods available in a selection of Gold Bar's most popular flavours. With these Gold Bar Reload prefilled pods, enjoy a variety of delightful flavours and a supremely satisfying MTL experience. Each pod's Hyper Mesh Coil technology ensures a smooth, flavourful vape with every draw. The prefilled design eliminates the fuss of refills and maintenance, simplifying vaping to just enjoying the experience. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg salt nicotine e-liquid, providing a smoother throat hit and faster absorption for quick satisfaction of nicotine cravings. With the Reload prefilled pods, the rechargeable Gold Bar Reload Pod Kit offers a more sustainable and flavourful alternative to disposable vapes, making it easy to switch flavours without waste.
